title: Critic review of a documentation edit

steps.label: Edit and commit
steps.gloss: Revise the documentation and commit it on the session's branch.

steps.label: Number the edits
steps.gloss: `review DRAFT FILE --spans` prints the edits as line ranges E1, E2 and so on, measured against the call's base.

steps.label: Write the prompt
steps.gloss: Write the critic's prompt around the spans, with the session's own account of any earlier run.

steps.label: Print the prompt
steps.gloss: Print the whole critic prompt: the spans, and each kept trip with the session's reason.

gloss.gloss: A fresh critic reads the document against the peeves list and returns trips, clear ids, candidates and a verdict.
A fresh critic reads the document against the peeves list and returns trips, clear ids, candidates and a verdict. A kept trip whose reason it doubts goes under Kept, not counted as a trip.

steps.label: Carry the report
steps.gloss: Pass the critic's report to `review DRAFT FILE REPORT` as a file or on stdin. The tool cannot tell who wrote the text.

steps.label: Resolve the run
steps.gloss: Take the run's session and agent id, and read its prompt and report from the live transcript during the turn, or from the session record once archived.

steps.label: Set the verdict
steps.gloss: Parse the report's trips. A trip inside an edit fails the run.

gloss.gloss: Answer each trip inside an edit: changed, or kept with a reason of 200 characters at most. A kept answer holds for that run only.
Answer each trip inside an edit: changed, or kept with a reason. A kept answer carries to later runs while its quoted text is unchanged.

exits.label: FAIL
exits.when: The run failed: revise and run again, until a run returns PASS.

exits.label: text changed
exits.when: The text changed since the run: run again.

exits.label: all answered
exits.when: No trip inside an edit is left unanswered.

gloss.gloss: `add` files the documentation call. It refuses one whose edits the last run did not read, or that leaves a trip unanswered.
`add` files the documentation call, checking the runs it references. It refuses one whose edits the last run did not read, or that leaves a trip unanswered.
Keep or reject each edit on the session page.
Keep or reject each edit on the session page, with kept trips and their reasons shown first.
